name: FLA Blog — AI Draft → SEO Review → Publish

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Manual Trigger').first().json.model || 'gpt-4o', temperature: 0.7, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: $json.messages }) }}

nodes.name: Draft with GPT
nodes.notes: Uses an HTTP Header Auth credential named `openaiApi` so the key is never stored in this file. Swap this node for the native OpenAI node if you prefer.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'SEO validation failed after 2 attempts. Errors: ' + JSON.stringify($json.__errors) }}

nodes.name: Send for Review
nodes.notes: Paste your Slack incoming webhook URL here. Swap for the Gmail/Telegram node if you review somewhere else.

nodes.name: Wait for Approval
nodes.notes: Activate the workflow to get the resume URL, then POST {"approve": true} to it. The 14-day limit stops approvals expiring forever.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, $('SEO Validate').first().json.payload, { published: true, published_at: new Date().toISOString() })) }}

nodes.name: Publish
nodes.notes: published_at is only sent on first publish; the webhook merges, so re-publishing a correction keeps the original date.

nodes.name: Ping Search Engines
nodes.notes: Best-effort crawl hint. Does not replace Search Console submission.
